story.headline: Ahmedabad woman's death was murder by father and brother, police say
story.body:
Police in Ahmedabad have concluded that the death of a 22-year-old woman initially recorded as a road accident was in fact a killing, according to the intake note on this story. The woman has been named in the reporting as Sofia Farooq.

News18 Hindi reported that Sofia was killed with a hammer by her father and brother, and that the scene was subsequently arranged to resemble a traffic crash. That account has not yet been independently verified by this desk.

According to News18 Hindi, the dispute that preceded the killing followed a video that had circulated widely online, and involved questions of family honour. The report does not, as summarised on the wire, set out what the video showed or how it came to be shared.

The intake note says police are the source for the finding that the death was a killing rather than an accident. No police officer has been named in the material available, and no direct quotes from investigators are in hand.

Before this runs, the desk needs to confirm: the exact date, time and location of the death; whether the father and brother have been arrested and what charges, if any, have been filed; the names of the accused; the identity of the police station or officer making the claim; how and when investigators reclassified the case; and any statement from the family or their lawyer. The nature and content of the viral video, and its connection to the killing, are also unconfirmed. None of this should be published on a single outlet's reporting alone.

blocks.label: Headline
lines: अहमदाबाद में युवती की मौत हादसा नहीं, पिता और भाई ने की हत्या: पुलिस

blocks.label: Body
lines: इस खबर से जुड़े इनटेक नोट के अनुसार, अहमदाबाद पुलिस इस नतीजे पर पहुंची है कि 22 वर्षीय एक युवती की जिस मौत को शुरू में सड़क हादसा दर्ज किया गया था, वह दरअसल एक हत्या थी। रिपोर्टिंग में युवती की पहचान सोफिया फारूक के रूप में बताई गई है।

न्यूज18 हिंदी ने खबर दी है कि सोफिया की हत्या उसके पिता और भाई ने हथौड़े से की और बाद में घटनास्थल को इस तरह तैयार किया गया कि वह सड़क दुर्घटना जैसा लगे। इस डेस्क ने अभी तक स्वतंत्र रूप से इस विवरण की पुष्टि नहीं की है।

न्यूज18 हिंदी के मुताबिक, हत्या से पहले हुआ विवाद ऑनलाइन बड़े पैमाने पर प्रसारित हुए एक वीडियो के बाद शुरू हुआ था और इसमें पारिवारिक इज्जत का सवाल जुड़ा था। वायर पर जिस रूप में यह रिपोर्ट सामने आई है, उसमें यह नहीं बताया गया कि वीडियो में क्या था या वह कैसे साझा हुआ।

इनटेक नोट में कहा गया है कि यह मौत हादसा नहीं बल्कि हत्या थी — इस निष्कर्ष का स्रोत पुलिस है। उपलब्ध सामग्री में किसी पुलिस अधिकारी का नाम नहीं दिया गया है और जांचकर्ताओं का कोई सीधा बयान भी हाथ में नहीं है।

इसे प्रकाशित करने से पहले डेस्क को इन बातों की पुष्टि करनी होगी: मौत की सटीक तारीख, समय और स्थान; क्या पिता और भाई गिरफ्तार हुए हैं और उन पर कौन-से आरोप, यदि कोई हैं, दर्ज किए गए हैं; आरोपियों के नाम; यह दावा करने वाले पुलिस थाने या अधिकारी की पहचान; जांचकर्ताओं ने मामले को कब और कैसे पुनर्वर्गीकृत किया; और परिवार या उनके वकील का कोई बयान। वायरल वीडियो की प्रकृति और सामग्री, तथा हत्या से उसका संबंध भी अपुष्ट है। इनमें से कुछ भी केवल एक ही आउटलेट की रिपोर्टिंग के आधार पर प्रकाशित नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।

brief.headline: Ahmedabad woman's death was murder by father and brother, police say
brief.body:
Police in Ahmedabad have concluded that the death of a 22-year-old woman initially recorded as a road accident was in fact a killing, according to the intake note on this story. The woman has been named in the reporting as Sofia Farooq.

News18 Hindi reported that Sofia was killed with a hammer by her father and brother, and that the scene was subsequently arranged to resemble a traffic crash. That account has not yet been independently verified by this desk.

According to News18 Hindi, the dispute that preceded the killing followed a video that had circulated widely online, and involved questions of family honour. The report does not, as summarised on the wire, set out what the video showed or how it came to be shared.

The intake note says police are the source for the finding that the death was a killing rather than an accident. No police officer has been named in the material available, and no direct quotes from investigators are in hand.

Before this runs, the desk needs to confirm: the exact date, time and location of the death; whether the father and brother have been arrested and what charges, if any, have been filed; the names of the accused; the identity of the police station or officer making the claim; how and when investigators reclassified the case; and any statement from the family or their lawyer. The nature and content of the viral video, and its connection to the killing, are also unconfirmed. None of this should be published on a single outlet's reporting alone.
